functions.brief: Enable/disable, or toggle, a server option via the command channel. 'option' is the option value to be changed (for example, NS_SERVER_LOGQUERIES or NS_SERVER_LOGRESPOSNES) and 'optname' is the option's human-readable name for logging purposes ("query logging" or "response logging").
functions.detailed:
If an explicit argument to enable the option was provided (i.e., "on", "enable", "true", or "yes") or an explicit argument to disable it ("off", "disable", "false", or "no"), it will be used.
If no argument is provided, the option's current state will be reversed.
